sources.snippet: Fork notice. This is a clone of Meta's official I-JEPA codebase — facebookresearch/ijepa (paper, CVPR-23) — with one fix applied: single-GPU training was broken upstream (main.py always spawned a worker process via mp.Process even for a single device, and init_distributed () tried to init a NCCL process group, which hangs waiting for peer ranks that never join). Fixed in two files: main.py ...

sources.snippet: I-JEPA Model (Huge, fine-tuned on IN1K) I-JEPA is a method for self-supervised learning.
